title: You Can't Stop Martinfish 3.0...
summary: Martinfish 3.0: instead of random sampling, the bot follows a fixed cycle - Stockfish plays three moves, then Martin plays one move, then Stockfish three, and so on. Filmed live with Martin and Stockfish open separately. Player (white, London) knows which moves are Martin's and plays solid chess, waiting for Martin's turns to make mistakes; after ~40 moves Martin plays Kd8 and the player mates. Won.
rules: Bot move schedule repeats: Stockfish (3600) move, Stockfish move, Stockfish move, Martin (250) move, ...
The player can know whose turn it is (deterministic cycle; video showed it openly).
